evals.name: webhook-execution-code-understanding
evals.prompt:

evals.name: permission-prompt-component-variants
evals.prompt: 帮我做一个 permission prompt 的交互式 variants HTML，方便工程和设计一起收敛 API。情境：用户授权一个助手读取 workspace 的项目名、状态和 owner；只能读，不能编辑或删除；授权可以撤销。需要比较 standard、quiet、framed、accent、dark、inline 六个语义 variant。现场可以调 padding、border 和是否有轻微 elevation；选中 variant 或改设置后，旁边要同步显示适用场景，并更新一段组件调用代码。不要把 hover 当成唯一交互，也不要做假的 Allow 请求。
evals.expected_output: 一个自包含的简体中文 component-variants HTML：用可键盘操作的 live variant lab 比较六个语义 variant，控件实时更新预览、适用场景和实现契约代码，不触发网络或伪造授权结果
assertions: Self-contained single .html file with no external resource loads, sample-company identity, or template residue
Required metadata present: viewport, meaningful title, zh lang, and effective-html-family set to component-variants
The variant question preserves the supplied read-only, revocable permission scope before presenting visual choices
All six named semantic variants are selectable with keyboard-operable controls; hover is not the only interaction
Padding, border, and restrained elevation controls are wired to update the live preview
Selecting a variant updates contextual-fit guidance, and all tuning changes update the implementation contract code
The preview does not issue a network request or present a fake successful authorization flow
Reader order is variant question → live variant lab → contextual fit → implementation contract, with canonical Claude document roles (#FAF9F5, #EFE9DE, #181715, #CC785C)
